report:
Independently reviewed the entire isolated_completion claim, all five implementation associations across expr.rs, infer_ctx.rs and method.rs, and both test entries. Captured the checking design, accepted transaction RFD, egraph lifecycle helper, staged-obligation type and body-query caller. Source inspection only; no behavioral suites rerun and no source edits.

The claim requires child-version speculation, rollback of equalities/wakes/staged obligations, atomic successful publication, and fallback plus terminal obligation processing before freezing a result with no live work. The associated external method instantiator creates a ROOT child, allocates generic inference variables there, and relates receiver/arguments within that version. Any mismatch discards the child and returns before publishing obligations. On success it stages the parameter environment, commits the child, then publishes that batch. The captured egraph lifecycle enforces an exclusive leaf child/direct-parent collapse, transfers equality/bound/domain/revision state and returns collected wake effects; discard removes child states. InferCtx commit_branch rebuilds before collapse and publishes wakes only from committed effects. The obligation batch is ordinary owned staging data and is published explicitly, so failure before publication does not register its obligations.

expr.rs is the body expression entry that invokes method resolution and consumes its successful target; infer_ctx.rs supplies the shared transaction/completion lifecycle. finalize processes ready obligations, defaults deferred never targets, resolves final bounds and diagnoses unresolved variables, retries obligations after fallback, terminally discharges remaining obligations, and drains wakes/runtime. finish consumes the context and asserts no pending obligations, live root child, active runtime task, unpublished wake or unfilled expression slot before producing CheckedBody. The captured LocalFnSym::body confirms the caller invokes finalize before finish. These are concrete safeguards, not proof that every speculative relation and completion scenario has been exhaustively exercised.

The ordinary external_method_mismatch_discards_partial_generic_bindings test uses the in-file SignatureTcx fixture with owner generic T, method generic E and parameters E then bool. The receiver binds T to bool; the first argument can partially bind E to a caller variable; the second char argument then rejects bool. The test requires failure, verifies the caller variable remains Bound::None and verifies the root semantic revision is unchanged. This genuinely checks rollback after partial matching, rather than immediate rejection. Its fixture and helper are present in the associated method.rs source. It does not observe wake queues, staged obligations, accepted commits or a complete body-finalization run.

The explicit checking_body_isolated_completion TODO retains exactly those wider prerequisites: rejected-candidate checks for leaked bindings/wakes/obligations, accepted-candidate atomic commit observations, residual-obligation diagnostics, and successful completion with empty runtime/wake/obligation/live-transaction state. The prerequisite is completing that claim-specific matrix across representative speculative operations and finalization paths. It contains no executable assertions and remains visibly deferred. The narrow ordinary rollback regression and inspected guards are not promoted to proof of all shared transaction rules. Every implementation entry, test and claim requirement is accounted for; no concrete additional defect was found and no edits are requested.
